data.title: Walk Safe New Mexico
data.description: This website is a service of the New Mexico Department of Transportation (NMDOT), developed as a part of the state’s Pedestrian Safety Action Plan. It provides local governments, Tribes, and New Mexico residents more information about planning, funding, and building safe facilities for pedestrians. Encouraging walking is important for our personal health, as well as the health of our communities. Almost all New Mexicans are a pedestrian at some point in their day – even if they primarily get around by car – and many in our state are reliant on walking or rolling due to age, income, or disability, or other factors. New Mexico currently faces a pedestrian safety crisis, with the highest rate of pedestrian fatalities per capita in the United States. By incorporating the best practices in pedestrian planning and facility design, local governments, Tribes and NMDOT are working to make walking safer and more comfortable for all New Mexicans and its visitors.
